scientific_question: Under the frozen zero-shot prompt, workspace projection, accepted WELL-EBNF-1/XGrammar hard constraint, and no-repair policy, can Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B produce semantically equivalent ScopeNormalizedProgram outputs on the six frozen pilot cases?

constraint.source: accepted WELL-EBNF-1 generated from frozen ClosedNormalizedProgram lineage

inference.runtime_rule: The pilot must reproduce the accepted inference_config_sha256 exactly. A runtime/device/dtype/version mismatch stops before model inference; do not silently switch CPU/GPU or dtype.

execution_authorized: implement any minimal private experiment-only pilot runner needed to execute the already-frozen design
reverify every accepted preflight identity/hash and six-case pre-inference hash before model load
load the pinned local Qwen3-1.7B model weights exactly once after all pre-run gates pass
execute exactly one constrained generation attempt per frozen case, in the frozen order, for exactly six high-level decomposer inference calls total
use the accepted XGrammar 0.2.8 HF LogitsProcessor with the accepted native grammar
record generated token ids including termination metadata
derive payload token ids by excluding only framework/XGrammar-authorized terminal stop token ids; no content repair or normalization
decode payload token ids deterministically with cleanup disabled and persist exact UTF-8 output bytes plus SHA-256
freeze each completed candidate before any oracle access
evaluate only through the accepted NL-PROGRAM-EVAL-HARNESS-01R2 after candidate freeze
persist complete per-case evaluation results and mechanically compute the frozen Layer 0/1/2 summary and decision

call_accounting.internal_forward_passes: AUTHORIZED only as implementation detail of the six generation calls; record diagnostics if available but do not count them as additional decomposer calls
call_accounting.case_local_generation_failure: Count the attempted generation as that case's sole call and record DECOMPOSITION_DECODE_FAILURE. Do not retry. Continue only if the same loaded model/runtime remains healthy and all frozen invariants still hold.
call_accounting.shared_infrastructure_failure: STOP the run; do not reload/substitute/change runtime. Preserve partial evidence and mark run INCOMPLETE/INVALID_FOR_SCIENTIFIC_DECISION.

pre_run_hard_gates: accepted preflight closure exists and is HUMAN/SOL ACCEPTED
prompt and serializer hashes match exactly
inference_config_sha256 matches exactly, including CPU/float32/torch runtime fields
six pre-inference case hashes recompute exactly in frozen order
no oracle/gold data reachable by the model-input construction path
per_case_protocol: recompute and verify frozen DecomposerInput/workspace/utterance/rendered-model-input/constraint/inference hashes before the call
construct model input from utterance + ProjectedWorkspace only; case_id remains evaluator-side only
instantiate a fresh XGrammar HF LogitsProcessor for the case
perform one greedy generate invocation with the frozen configuration
record call index, case id, start/end/latency, input hashes, generated token ids, termination reason, completion state, raw payload bytes, raw payload sha256
if decode is complete, call freeze_candidate() before any oracle access
if frozen, evaluate through accepted harness and persist the complete EvaluationResult
if decode cannot produce a complete legal object, label DECOMPOSITION_DECODE_FAILURE without retry

output_boundary.raw_output_definition: UTF-8 decode of generated payload token ids after removing only trailing authorized framework/XGrammar stop token ids; no whitespace trimming, JSON fixing, field insertion, semantic normalization, or other repair.

mechanical_summary.layer2: mechanism attribution + frozen Veto A/B using the accepted case/label map
decision_rules: If Layer 0 != 6/6: INCONCLUSIVE (constraint/decode/infrastructure attribution; not a decomposer-family failure).
If Layer 0 = 6/6 and semantic equivalence = 6/6: STRONG PASS.
If Layer 0 = 6/6 and semantic equivalence >=5/6: CONTINUE FAMILY unless Layer-2 critical-mechanism veto fires.
If Layer 0 = 6/6 and semantic equivalence <=4/6: STOP / REDESIGN.
If >=5/6 but frozen critical-mechanism veto fires: STOP / REDESIGN.

forbidden: different model snapshot or model family
SLM-02/SLM-03 adapters or any fine-tuning adapter
retry, repair, self-critique, best-of-N, fallback decode
manual semantic scoring or decision override
more than six high-level inference calls

result_policy.completion: A complete scientific run requires exactly six case attempts in frozen order with complete evidence, regardless of semantic success/failure.
result_policy.stop_for_review: After the run artifacts and immutable candidate/tip are published, STOP for independent scientific review.
result_policy.no_automatic_followup: Do not start broader heldout evaluation, fine-tuning, model comparison, production integration, or a rerun without a later authority.
